```{r include=FALSE}
library(MASS)
```

## **Simulation:**

```{r}

corSignedP <- function(s1, s2){
	test <- cor.test(s1, s2)
	P <- test$p.value
	if (test$statistic <0) return(P)
	return(1-P)
}
```

```{r}
simCorr <- function(n){
  dat.null <- mvrnorm(n, c(0,0), matrix(c(1, 0, 0, 1), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))
  dat.null.sqr <- dat.null; dat.null.sqr[,2] <- dat.null.sqr[,1]^2
  
  dat.corr <- mvrnorm(n, c(0,0), matrix(c(1, 1, 1, 1), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))
  dat.corr.sqr <- dat.corr; dat.corr.sqr[,2] <- dat.corr.sqr[,2]^2
  
  pval.null <- corSignedP(dat.null[,1], dat.null[,2])
  pval.null.nonlin <- corSignedP(dat.null.sqr[,1], dat.null.sqr[,2])
  pval.corr <- corSignedP(dat.corr[,1], dat.corr[,2]) 
  pval.corr.sqr <- corSignedP(dat.corr.sqr[,1], dat.corr.sqr[,2]) 
  
  pvals <- c("null" = pval.null, "null.nonlin" = pval.null.nonlin, 
             "corr" = pval.corr, "corr.sqr" = pval.corr.sqr)
  return(pvals)
}
```

```{r}
numSims <- 10000
sampSize <- 10
pvals <- replicate(numSims, simCorr(sampSize))
```
\newpage

**Case 1: Centered Null Distribution**

```{r}
dat.null <- mvrnorm(sampSize, c(0,0), matrix(c(1, 0, 0, 1), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))
plot(dat.null)

hist(pvals[1,], breaks = seq(0,1,length.out = 41))
```

\newpage

**Case 2: Squaring the Null Distribution (Non-linearity in one marginal)**

```{r}
dat.null.sqr <- dat.null; dat.null.sqr[,2] <- dat.null.sqr[,2]^2
plot(dat.null.sqr)

hist(pvals[2,], breaks = seq(0,1,length.out = 41))
```

\newpage

**Case 3: Correlated Data**

```{r}
dat.corr <- mvrnorm(sampSize, c(0,0), matrix(c(1, 1, 1, 1), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))
plot(dat.corr)

hist(pvals[3,], breaks = seq(0,1,length.out = 41))
```

\newpage

**Case 4: Squaring the Correlated Data(Non-linearity in one marginal)**

```{r}
dat.corr.sqr <- dat.corr; dat.corr.sqr[,2] <- dat.corr.sqr[,2]^2
plot(dat.corr.sqr)

hist(pvals[4,], breaks = seq(0,1,length.out = 41))
```
